name: Wikipedia

intro.Donations: Fundraising banners and donation prompts. You can still donate from the menu.
intro.Privacy: Usage analytics, the install ID and permissions. They change nothing you see.
intro.App: Surveys and prompts the app shows by itself, and parts of the app you may not want.

summary: Hide the fundraising banners and pop-up prompts, and stop the usage analytics and the install ID sent with every request, without an account.

android.note: Wikipedia needs Android 7 (minSdk 24). The universal APK bundle has x86_64 libraries, so the emulator runs it natively. The release tries the oldest Android version tested here, the newest stable one and the next one; a pull request the oldest and the newest stable.

checks.screen: All the world's knowledge|Learn more about Wikipedia
checks.screen_shown: The welcome screen (All the world's knowledge) is showing.
checks.screen_missing: The welcome screen (All the world's knowledge) didn't show within a minute.

versions.phone_test: read an article, search and open the More menu on a phone: the emulator test only starts the app.
